hypotheses.D0_local_positive_coalition_is_direction: A pair-local rank-64 support selected by positive first-order semantic contribution increases the donor-label output score on at least 75% of finite patches.
hypotheses.D1_local_positive_generalizes_across_pai: It remains directionally correct on at least 70% of uniformly sampled pairs.
hypotheses.D2_local_absolute_support_tracks_full_pa: A pair-local absolute-contribution support has at least 0.60 correlation with the full product-patch class-score shift.
hypotheses.D3_dynamic_support_beats_fixed_semantic_: The local-positive support's mean signed shift is at least twice the frozen activation-only support's shift.
hypotheses.D4_first_order_sign_survives_finite_patc: At least 80% of local-positive patches retain the positive direction predicted by the exact recipient-state derivative.
hypotheses.D5_dynamic_selector_is_an_upper_bound: The selector reads the held-out donor-recipient activation delta and recipient suffix gradient, so it is an endpoint-informed mechanistic upper bound rather than a prospective semantic decoder.
